findings.current: The head of a monster as large as a house.
findings.defect: The English makes the monster itself house-sized, while the source specifically says its head is as large as a house.
findings.rationale: 집채만 한 directly modifies 괴수의 머리, establishing the size of the head rather than the overall creature.

findings.current: That was the entirety of my preparation. This spear was my magic, and there was no way it could stop me.
findings.defect: The object of Carus’s inability to stop is changed from the spear to Taekyung.
findings.rationale: 이 창 is the antecedent of what 놈 cannot stop; the source describes the spear’s unstoppable force, not merely Taekyung’s advance.
findings.replacement: That was the entirety of my preparation. This spear was my magic, and the creature would never be able to stop it.
findings.source: 예비 동작은 그것이 전부였다. 이 창이 내 마법이고 놈은 결코 막을 수 없을 것이다.

findings.current: The moment I escaped the area affected by Slow at arrowlike speed, dozens of arrows made of thorny vines and mana blocked my path.
findings.defect: The draft combines two distinct attacks—thorny vines and dozens of mana arrows—into composite arrows made from both, and 빛살 is a streak or ray of light rather than an arrow.
findings.rationale: The coordination in 가시넝쿨과 마력으로 이루어진 수십 개의 화살 distinguishes the vines from the arrows made of mana.
findings.replacement: The moment I shot beyond Slow’s area of effect like a streak of light, thorny vines and dozens of mana arrows blocked my path.
findings.source: 빛살 같은 속도로 감속 마법이 미치는 범위를 벗어나자마자 가시넝쿨과 마력으로 이루어진 수십 개의 화살이 앞을 가로막는다.

findings.defect: The draft changes the single chopped-off tail into multiple pieces.
findings.rationale: 토막 난 꼬리 refers here to the tail segment Taekyung severed with one strike and that subsequently rolled through the dust, not a tail divided into several pieces.
findings.source: 잘려 나간 두 날개와 토막 난 꼬리. 제 기능을 하지 못하는 두 눈.

findings.current: Its hollow eye sockets, pouring dark-red blood like waterfalls, turned toward me.
findings.defect: A singular, ruined eye is changed into two empty eye sockets.
findings.rationale: 눈동자가 and 쏟아지는 are singular, and the source describes the freshly pierced eye rather than two hollow sockets.
findings.replacement: Its gaping eye, pouring dark-red blood like a waterfall, turned toward me.
findings.source: 검붉은 피가 폭포수처럼 쏟아지는 뻥 뚫린 눈동자가 나를 향했다.

findings.current: With a voice barely loud enough to hear, I thrust the spear forward with all my strength.
findings.defect: The draft adds that Taekyung uses all his strength; the source only says he thrusts forcefully.
findings.rationale: 힘주어 indicates deliberate force, not the exhaustive maximum expressed by “with all my strength.”
findings.replacement: With that barely audible whisper, I drove the spear forward.
findings.source: 들릴 듯 말 듯 한 목소리와 함께 힘주어 창을 내질렀다.

findings.current: —What. kind. of. bull. shit. is. that?
findings.defect: The translation removes the deliberate 오크 소리 wordplay, which substitutes “orc” into a familiar expression meaning nonsense or bullshit.
findings.rationale: Retaining “orc” preserves Carus’s monster-themed distortion of the insult without sanitizing its hostile register.
findings.replacement: —What. kind. of. orc. shit. is. that?
findings.source: - 그. 게. 무. 슨. 오. 크. 소. 리. 냐!

findings.current: “While I’m at it, I’ll throw in a massive bleeding service. Fifty Strength. Fifty Stamina.”
findings.defect: “Massive bleeding service” is an opaque calque that sounds like a combat effect and loses the mock promotional language about spending points lavishly.
findings.rationale: 대출혈 서비스 is sales language for an extravagant giveaway at the giver’s expense; “splurge on a bonus” preserves both the promotional joke and Taekyung’s point expenditure.
findings.replacement: “While I’m at it, I’ll splurge on a bonus. Fifty Strength. Fifty Stamina.”
findings.source: “하는 김에 대출혈 서비스 해 준다. 근력 50. 체력 50.”

findings.current: —……What. is. with. that. re. laxed. at. ti. tude?
findings.defect: The line is an unnatural literal rendering of Carus asking why Taekyung remains so composed.
findings.rationale: 그 여유 refers to Taekyung’s conspicuous composure; the replacement preserves Carus’s halting delivery in natural English.

findings.current: “They have something they trust enough to stay relaxed.”
findings.defect: The phrasing is stiff and does not land as the concise completion of Taekyung’s two-part setup.
findings.rationale: 믿는 구석 means having reliable grounds for confidence; the replacement naturally completes the preceding contrast with bluffing.
findings.replacement: “Or they have a good reason to be.”

findings.defect: A wet penetration sound effect is rendered as an imperative or action label.
findings.rationale: 푸욱 is the sound of the spear sinking into Carus’s brow, not narration naming the action.

findings.current: Team Leader Choi, Butler Kim, Im Kkeokjeong, and Song Song.
findings.defect: The draft flattens the source’s deliberate pause before Song Song, removing her distinct emotional emphasis.
findings.rationale: The source separates 송송이 into its own sentence fragment, marking her out from the rest of the approaching group.
findings.replacement: Team Leader Choi, Butler Kim, Im Kkeokjeong. Song Song.
findings.source: 최 팀장, 김 집사, 임꺽정. 송송이.

findings.current: Watching them run toward me as if competing with one another, I couldn’t help but laugh.
findings.defect: The generic involuntary laugh omits the drained, collapsing quality conveyed by 풀썩 after the battle.
findings.rationale: 풀썩 gives the reaction a sense of Taekyung finally going slack with exhaustion and relief, rather than simply finding the sight amusing.
findings.replacement: Watching them race toward me, I let out a weary laugh.
findings.source: 경쟁하듯 달려오는 그들을 바라보며, 나는 풀썩 웃어 버렸다.

summary: Several scene facts and combat mechanics are altered, and some jokes and register shifts are obscured by literal or unnatural phrasing.
